objective_breakdown: ED>=500.94 Wh/kg (stage2, contract calc-energy formula; thick electrodes raise ED toward active-layer asymptote while CC/separator fixed mass dilutes); 4C fast charge without plating (stage3, plated=false; 4C=20 A fixed vs nominal 5 Ah so overcapacity design lowers effective charge SOC and anode plating risk); T_max<=333.15 K judged on 4C_charge_45C (45C ambient leaves only 15 K headroom; lumped thermal: need heat reduction + aggressive cooling h). Key contract mechanics: area is ED-neutral but 1/area safety lever; CC thinning is pure ED win (in-plane resistance unmodeled); trade-off ED-vs-charge is weak in this formulation, binding pair is ED vs T_max.
candidate_strategy: Round 1: baseline Chen2020 characterization + A1 ThickCCslim (electrodes x2, CC 8/6um, sep 10um — ED probe) + A2 TransportCool (sigma 2.0 S/m, t+ 0.45, D 4.5e-10, particles x0.5, h 200, area x1.5 — safety probe) + CeilProbe (extreme architecture+formulation combo; opening ceiling assessment recorded, escalation disabled per ablation). Rounds 2+: refine measured-effective levers (thickness/area/transport/h/N-P), DFN for passers, safety co-check (4C lumped+plating) every round.
budget_allocation: ~8 rounds max, <=4 candidates/round each with 1C SPMe (+DFN for passers) + calc-energy + 4C SPMe/DFN; DFN reserved for passers/finalists; closing deliverables after achievement or three-strike negative result.
risk_and_fallback: ED unreachable in architecture space -> three-strike questioning -> honest negative result with 'if X relaxed' note (ceiling_escalation OFF forbids material path); T_max failure -> h up (immersion-class), area up, heat down via transport/particles; plating -> overcapacity + area + particles + transport; parameter-name errors fixed via 'unknown parameter name(s)' validation; DFN solver failure auto-degrades to SPMe (screening-level only).
